title: Scripture and the Holy Spirit
definition: Scripture and the Holy Spirit means the Spirit inspired God’s Word, illuminates it to believers, and uses it to produce faith, holiness, comfort, and mission.
summary: Scripture and the Holy Spirit means the Spirit inspired God’s Word, illuminates it to believers, and uses it to produce faith, holiness, comfort, and mission.
christFocus: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit to glorify Him, remind His people of truth, and empower them to live and bear witness according to the Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit and Scripture are not rivals. The Spirit inspired the Word and works through the Word. He does not lead believers away from Scripture into contradiction, confusion, or self-centered spiritual claims.

The Spirit uses Scripture to convict, teach, comfort, strengthen, sanctify, and guide God’s people. He brings the truth of Christ to bear on the heart, not merely on the mind.

A Spirit-filled life is a Word-shaped life. The Spirit empowers believers to understand God’s truth, trust Christ, resist sin, bear fruit, and walk in obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers try to live the Christian life in their own strength, while others chase spiritual experiences without grounding in Scripture. This doctrine brings both together: dependence on the Spirit under the authority of the Word.

This is especially important for people in recovery, suffering, or ministry. Lasting transformation requires more than effort; believers need the Spirit applying God’s truth to the heart.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture in dependence on the Holy Spirit. Ask Him to reveal Christ, convict sin, comfort weakness, strengthen obedience, and empower you to live the Word rather than merely know it.
